newsitem.title: USA: NY physical coffee - spot diffs flat, forwards ease.
newsitem.headline: NY physical coffee - spot diffs flat, forwards ease.

text.p: Spot business on the New York physical coffee market continued to lag this week, as roasters shifted their focus to beans for foward delivery.
"Most business being done is for forward delivery," one trader said. "The shipment of forwards seems to be satisfying roasters."
Spreads on coffees for forward delivery inched lower as roasters anticipated the flow of new-crop beans from Central and South America in the coming months, dealers said.
But as recent inventory figures show, spot supplies were still hard to come by.
The Green Coffee Association reported earlier this week that U.S. warehouse stocks of green coffee declined by 93,000 60-kg bags in August, to 1,816,000 bags, their lowest level in seven years.
Meanwhile, the CSCE's certified stock figures were unchanged on the week at 42,677 60-kg bags.
But for now, tight nearby availability underpinned spot differentials this week.
With Colombian beans expected to remain relatively scarce until October, spot Colombian MAMs were unchanged on the week, with offers heard at 24-25 cents over CSCE December.
